component.name: Sung
component.summary: YouTube Music, your music files, and your music server

description.p: A minimal Material 3 music player built with C++ and Qt Quick, native on Linux and Wayland. Sung plays YouTube Music, your own audio files and your music server from one interface.

ul.li: YouTube Music search and playback without an embedded browser
Navidrome, Subsonic and Jellyfin browsing, playback, playlists, ratings and synchronized lyrics
Local FLAC, MP3 and other audio files, browsed by album, artist or folder
Synchronized lyrics with an immersive view, timing adjustments and LRC import
Animated album artwork, artwork-derived colour and an ambient cover backdrop
Media keys through MPRIS, light and dark themes, and a pickable Material accent colour

description.p: Sung is an independent project and is not affiliated with Google or YouTube.
